Aug 2, 2026|News and Updates

National Health Center Week: Celebrating the People Behind the Care

National Health Center Week: Celebrating the People Behind the Care

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:53
Instaread

Each August, community health centers across the country come together to celebrate National Health Center Week, recognizing the important role health centers play in keeping communities healthy and improving access to quality care.

At Brevard Health Alliance, this week is also an opportunity to celebrate the people who make our mission possible every day.

From providers, nurses, medical assistants, dentists, hygienists, behavioral health professionals, pharmacists, patient access representatives, care coordinators, interpreters, billing specialists, facilities staff, and countless others, every member of our team plays an important role in helping patients receive the care they need.

Every day, our staff welcomes thousands of patients through our doors with compassion, professionalism, and a commitment to providing high-quality care close to home. Whether it’s helping a child prepare for the school year, supporting someone through the management of a chronic condition, connecting a family with needed services, or simply offering a reassuring smile, these everyday moments make a lasting impact.

A Week to Say Thank You

During National Health Center Week, we’ll take time to recognize our teams with staff appreciation events, clinic celebrations, leadership visits, and a few fun activities throughout the week. While these celebrations may seem simple, they reflect something important: our people are the heart of Brevard Health Alliance.

We’re also grateful for the trust our patients place in us and for the many community organizations, schools, businesses, and partners who work alongside us to improve the health of Brevard County. Together, we’re able to serve more than patients—we’re helping build healthier families and stronger communities.

Thank You for Being Part of Our Story

As we celebrate National Health Center Week, we extend our sincere thanks to our employees, volunteers, partners, and patients. Your dedication, support, and trust make our work possible.

Here’s to another year of caring for our community—together.
